messages.text:
Hey!

I'm checking to see what the status on my Nexus L1 order is?

When I placed this order, the Nexus L1 was "In Stock," but now the your
website says there's no estimate on shipment.

Cheers!
Jon

Hi Jon,

Thanks for writing in, and sorry for the uncertainty on this.

The honest answer on the Nexus L1 is that it ships with the Nexus batch coming in from the manufacturer, and that batch is running behind. We do not have a confirmed date back from them yet, which is why the listing no longer shows one. I would rather tell you that than give you a date we cannot keep. You can follow that shipment on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

So I can tell you exactly where your own order sits, could you reply with your order number (it looks like Shop····)? I will check what the warehouse is holding against it and come back to you.

And if you would rather not wait on the batch, say so with that order number and I will look at swapping it for something we have on the shelf now, priced to the cent before you decide.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Sarah,

I appreciate the prompt, honest response

My order number is: Shop····

I would rather not wait on the Nexus batch if it's running behind. Please
let me know what the swap options are.

Thanks!
Jon

Hi Jon,

Thanks, I have order Shop···· open in front of me. Your Bitfortun BS-2 shipped on September 12 and was delivered on the 25th. The N. L1 is the one still outstanding, and it has been since you ordered on September 8, with no restock date back from the manufacturer. Sorry you have been waiting on it this long.

Here is what I can move it to today, both sitting on the shelf at our US warehouse.

The closest like for like is the Hammer Miner DC06, 330 MH/s against the L1's 320, at $379.99. In stock, ships within 2 business days. It is $20.00 less than the L1, so that $20.00 goes back to your original payment when I make the change.

If you want the step up, the Hammer Miner DC08 is 480 MH/s at $539.00, also in stock and shipping within 2 business days. That one is $139.01 more than the L1, so you would get an invoice for the difference and it ships once that is paid.

Either way the BS-2 side of the order is untouched and your order number stays the same. Just reply DC06 or DC08 and I will make the swap and confirm it back to you.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
